question: Cosmetics Shop: xếp hạng 3 danh mục sản phẩm cao nhất theo người xem sản phẩm duy nhất, từ 2020-01-06 đến hết 2020-01-18; nếu bằng nhau thì xếp danh mục sản phẩm tăng dần, giá trị thiếu cuối cùng.
gold_sql: SELECT item_category AS item_category, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name='view')::bigint AS viewers FROM analytics.event_activity WHERE source_id='cosmetics_shop' AND event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-06' AND '2020-01-18' AND event_name='view' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY viewers DESC NULLS LAST, item_category ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

question: Olist: how do buyer-to-observed-user rate split across product category, from 2018-01-15 through 2018-01-28?
gold_sql: SELECT item_category AS item_category, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name='order_purchased')::numeric / nullif(count(DISTINCT user_id),0) AS buyer_conversion_rate FROM analytics.event_activity WHERE source_id='olist_marketplace' AND event_date BETWEEN '2018-01-15' AND '2018-01-28' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY item_category NULLS LAST
